title: Mediterranean style Tomato on Toast
description: Deliciously fresh start to your day with Mediterranean flavours.A filling combination that is a perfect example of the Mediterranean diet with beneficial fats, protein and carbs.

ingredients.name: 4 x thick slices of bread (your preferred)
1/2 cup of Basil leaves, roughly torn to top

steps.title: Pre-heat oven to 200°
Scoop 1 Avocado into a small bowl. Squeeze juice and lime zest from 1 lime into the bowl
steps.description: May wish to use a stick blender to avoid hand fatigue for avocado mixing step.

steps.title: Mash avocado mixture with a fork or potato masher
Crumble 200g of fetta into a bowl and add ¼ cup of milk
steps.description: Use a blender to combine milk and fetta

steps.title: Drizzle Olive Oil on bread pieces.
Slice one garlic clove in half and rub onto each bread piece.
Put bread in the oven to toast on both sides.
steps.description: Bread will only need 30sec-1min in the oven on each side.

steps.title: Remove the bread from oven. Once cooled, spread avocado mixture onto each slice of bread.
Spread feta mixture on top of the avocado
Place sliced tomatoes on top of the fetta
Sprinkle torn basil leaves on the sliced tomatoes.

title: Lamb Racks with Bean Casserole
description: The perfect meal to treat yourself. This recipe is sure to make you feel like a master chef.

ingredients.name: ½ cup Mint, very finely chopped

steps.title: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Heat frypan to medium, add 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Brown 2 lamb racks on all sides in pan.
Transfer lamb to a roasting dish.
In small bowl, combine:
steps.description:
½ cup chopped mint,
2 cloves crushed garlic,
2 tablespoon grated parmesan
¼ cup bread crumbs

steps.title: Spread 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard on top and on sides of lamb.
Using a teaspoon, stick bread crumb mixture on top of mustard to form a crust.
Bake in oven (15 minutes = rare, 30 minutes = well done)
Drain and rinse the 1 can 4-bean mix in a colander.
For bean casserole, combine ingredients:
steps.description:
1 can 4-bean mix
½ cup Parsley, chopped
¼ cup Balsamic vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp Extra virgin olive oil

Into frypan, warm and mix.

steps.title: Serve lamb on top of bean casserole with a side of vegetables.

title: Homemade Muesli
description:
A simple, nutritious breakfast that you can customise and make your own!source of fibre.
Hint:
May wish to pre-prepare dry mix of oats, seeds and bran/puff rice in proportion for convenience and just use a cup measure each time.

ingredients.name: 1⁄4 cup All Bran or puffed rice

steps.title: Place all dry ingredients into a bowl and mix:
steps.description:
½ cup rolled oats
¼ cup Puffed rice *or*All Bran
1 tsp sunflower seeds
1 tsp pumpkin seeds
1 tbsp sultanas
6x almonds, chopped

steps.title: Sprinkle ¼ teaspoon Cinnamon on top.
Add ½ cup milk
Add yoghurt and serve

title: Snapper with Braised Beans & Tomatoes
description: A hearty and wholesome fish dinner. The tomato sauce pair perfectly with the beans and really fulfils the dish.

steps.title: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in large fry pan (with a lid) to medium.
Place 1 thinly sliced onion in pan, cook until soft.
Add the 2 cloves crushed garlic and 2 tablespoon fennel seeds and cook for one minute extra.
Add 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 2 cup green beans to pan, stir then cover with lid.
Lower heat to simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat remaining oil in a fry pan to medium heat.
Place 2 snapper fillets into the pan, skin down. Cook 4 minutes until skin crispy.
Turn fillets over and cook further 2 minutes until cooked through.
To serve, stir ½ cup roughly chopped parsley through the beans mix.
steps.description:
Divide bean mix onto 2 plates.
Scatter ¼ cup shaved parmesan over and place a snapper on top of each plate.

title: Cheese and Spinach Triangles
description: A quick and easy meal for when you need something fancy. Can be made in advance and frozen for when needed most.

ingredients.name: 250g Frozen spinach, thawed with moisture squeezed out

steps.title: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Place into large bowl:
steps.description:
3 eggs,
250g frozen spinach,
250g ricotta,
200g crumbled feta and
1 lemon (juice)

mix ingredients

steps.title: Cover filo pastry with damp tea towel to keep moist.
Take one sheet filo pastry, fold in half on longest side to make a long rectangle.
steps.description: Place 2 tablespoons of the spinach and ricotta mixture in the top right-hand corner of pastry

steps.title: Then fold the corner of the filo sheet with the mixture on it over itself to form a triangle.
Press edges of triangle down with fork to seal them,
Repeat process until all mixture used. Makes 10 triangles.
Line baking tray with baking paper.
Place triangles on tray 2-3 cm apart.
Bake 15-20 minutes until golden. Then serve!

title: Zucchini Fritters with Poached eggs and spinach
description: Like a hash brown only with zucchini and so delicious. A filling combination to keep your belly satisfied.

steps.title: Start by chopping:
steps.description:
1x onion,
2x tbsp mint.

steps.title: Grate:
steps.description:
2x zucchini
squeeze out moisture using clean chux cloth (see hints)

steps.title: Place fry pan on medium heat,
Add 1 teaspoon olive oil and diced onion into pan,
Cook onion until soft,
steps.description: Turn heat off.

steps.title: Place cooked onion into bowl with:
steps.description:
grated zucchini,
½ cup corn kernels,
2 tablespoons self-raising flour
½ cup parsley
2 tbsp of mint

steps.title: Crack 1 egg into a cup, and whisk egg with fork.
Turn pan heat to medium,
Add 1 tablespoon olive oil to pan,
Put 2 tablespoons of fritter mix into pan and flatten with back of spoon,
Cook fritters 2 minutes each side until golden,
Heat pan until boiling, then lower heat to simmer. Stir water with spoon to make a whirlpool,
Crack eggs into the water to cook for 3 minutes, repeat for 4 eggs total.
To serve, divide fritters between 2 plates, top with poached eggs and spinach.

title: Southern-Fried Chicken Drumsticks
description: A healthy twist on a kfc takeout classic. These drumsticks have everything you expect from a takeaway meal, just better for you!

steps.title: Preheat oven to 180°C
Place into zip-lock bag:
steps.description:
¼ cup flour
1 teaspoon Cumin
1 teaspoon smoked paprika
½ teaspoon white pepper
4 chicken drumsticks

 
Lightly shake bag to combine.

steps.title: Spray baking dish with oil and place coated chicken drumsticks in.
steps.description: Bake for 40mins until chicken cooked through

steps.title: Heat a saucepan to medium.
Drain and rinse 4-bean mix in a colander
Add to pan:
steps.description:
1 can 4-bean mix,
2 teaspoon Dijon mustard
¼ cup Balsamic Vinegar

Cook until bubbling.

steps.title: Remove from the heat and stir through the parsley.
Divide the bean casserole mixture between two plates.
steps.description:
Top with chicken
Serve with a side of vegetables.

title: Seafood Stew
description: This versatile Mediterranean stew is perfect year round. The combination of seafood, white wine and a herby broth is just as fitting for a meal on the veranda as it is for a date night.

steps.title: Heat large, saucepan over medium heat.
Add the 1 tablespoon olive oil and cook the 1 diced onion until soft.
Add the 2 cloves crushed garlic, cook one minute longer.
Add ½ diced red capsicum, cook and stir for 2 minutes.
Pour in ¼ cup white wine, cook off the alcohol for one minute, then add:
steps.description:
1 cup chicken stock and
Can of crushed tomato.

steps.title: Bring to the boil.
Add 300g seafood marinara mix and 6 prawns.
Cover and lower heat to simmer 10 mins.
Add 6 raw mussels in their shells,
steps.description:
Place lid on, simmer for 3 mins or until mussel shells open.
*note: discard any mussels whose shells fail to open*

steps.title: Divide seafood stew between 2 large bowls. Top with  ½ cup parsley and  ¼ cup parmesan.
steps.description: (optional) Serve with some bread drizzled in olive oil.

steps.title: Preheat your oven to 200°C.
Line an oven tray with baking paper.
Place 2 potatoes cut into wedges on tray and drizzle 2 tablespoons olive oil
Sprinkle 2 tablespoons dried oregano on top.
steps.description: Mix with your hands to coat evenly.

steps.title: Bake in the oven 10 minutes.
Turn the potatoes, Bake 10 minutes more until crisp.

ingredients.name: ½ cup grated Tasty Cheese (reduced salt)

steps.title: Place 2 wraps on bench.
Spread bean burrito mix on top of each.
Layer ½ cup tasty cheese then 2 cups English spinach
Top each wrap with another wrap.
Toast in toasted sandwich maker until cooked through.
steps.description: **Alternatively, cook in fry pan, turning halfway to cook both sides.

title: Hommus
description: A delicious “goes with anything savoury” snack

ingredients.name: ¼ cup Extra virgin olive oil

steps.title: Preheat oven to 180°C
Place 3 cloves garlic on baking tray.
steps.description: Bake 10 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Drain 1 can chickpeas in colander,
Rinse chickpeas with water in colander,
Rub chickpeas together with hands to remove skins.
steps.description: Place chickpeas in a small bowl.

steps.title: Squeeze baked garlic out of skin and into the bowl.
Add to bowl:
steps.description: ● 1 lemon (juice), ● ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil, ● ½ teaspoon cumin.

steps.title: Blend until smooth with stick blender.
steps.description: Serve with vegetable sticks or wholegrain crackers (optional).

title: Grilled Pears with Toasted Nuts Yoghurt & Mint
description: Grilled fruit for a sweetly satisfying morning meal.Get two serves of fruit to start the day!

steps.title: Prepare hazelnuts
steps.description:
Preheat your oven to 200°C.
Chop 3 tablespoons of hazelnuts.
Place nuts into a baking dish, put in oven for 4 minutes.
Remove nuts from the oven to cool.

steps.title: Heat a grill pan to medium.
Cut 3 pears in half, remove stone.
Place the pears cut side down and grill for 3 minutes.
Turn pears and grill for 3 minutes.
To serve, use 2 bowls. Put half the yoghurt in each bowl,
Place half the peaches on top. Sprinkle with nuts and ½ cup mint leaves.

title: Greek Salad
description: A classic, Greek salad. This fresh, vibrant salad embodies the essence of Mediterranean cuisine.

steps.title: Slice 1 baby cos lettuce
slice 1 punnet cherry tomatoes into halves
Peel then slice 1 cucumber
combine into a bowl:
steps.description: ● cos lettuce, ● cherry tomatos, ● sliced cucumber and ● 100g crumbled feta

steps.title: Drizzle 2 tablespoons olive oil over the top.
Squeeze ½ lemon juice and sprinkle 1 tablespoon oregano ontop, serve.

title: Crispy Skinned Barramundi with Braised Vegetables & Mint Yoghurt
description: Tender fish with a beautifully crispy skin, resting on a fresh and textural mix of greens.

ingredients.name: 1 Leek, halved and sliced (white part only)
½ cup Snow peas, cut into thirds

steps.title: Heat fry pan to medium, add 1 tablespoon olive oil.
Cook 2 barramundi fillets skin down for 4 minutes.
Turn fillets, cook another 2 minutes.
Heat a saucepan to medium. add 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 sliced leek (white part only), cook for 2 minutes.
steps.description:
Add 2 tablespoons olive oil and 1 sliced leek (white part only), cook for 2 minutes.
Add 1 clove crushed garlic, cook for one minute.

steps.title: Add these vegetables into saucepan:
steps.description:
1 Zucchini, sliced
½ cup Snow peas, cut into thirds
½ cup frozen peas
½ cup Chicken Stock (low salt)
1 bunch broccolini

Stir.

steps.title: Add ½ cup chicken stock to vegetables, bring to boil.
Then lower temperature and simmer for 3 minutes.
Combine ½ cup greek yoghurt, ½ a lemon juice and 2 tablespoons mint into a small bowl.
To serve, place layer of vegetables onto a plate, top with fish and mint yoghurt.

title: Creamy Mushroom & Spinach Toast
description: The name says it all! Delectable creamy mushrooms over toast for brekky

steps.title: Wipe off 350g mushrooms with a damp cloth, then thickly slice.
Heat pan to medium heat. Add 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 clove crushed garlic.
Add 350g sliced mushrooms to pan, cook until soft.
Add 1 cup spinach and stir until the spinach is wilted,
Add 1 tablespoon sour cream and stir through,
Serve mix on top of toasted bread (4 slices).

title: Chicken Pot Pies
description: These hearty pies will be sure to fill those home cooked meal cravings. Flavoursome and perfect for a mid week meal.

steps.title: Preheat oven to 200°C
Place flour and chicken thighs into a large zip lock bag. Shake to coat chicken.
Place a heavy bottomed casserole dish over a medium heat. Add 1 tbsp of oil.
Brown the chicken pieces in batches and set aside
Clean the casserole dish and place back on the heat with another tbsp of oil.
Cook the leek until soft then add the crushed garlic and cook for a further minute.
Add chicken, carrots and the stock to the dish.
Bring the chicken casserole to a boil then lower the heat. Cover and simmer for 30 mins.
Remove the lid and cook for a further 10-15mins until the chicken is cooked through and the cooking liquid has reduced
Using the top of your ramekins as a template, cut out the puff pastry to make a lid for your pies.
Divide the chicken and leek casserole among 4 x pie ramekins, top with the pastry lids using a fork to press down the edges.
Use a small sharp knife to slice a cross into the middle of the pastry to allow steam to escape during cooking and then brush the top with the lightly whisked egg.
Place the ramekins onto a baking dish and the bake for 10-15 minutes until the pastry is golden brown.
steps.description: Serve with a big bowl of steamed vegetables.

steps.title: Place 2 wraps on bench.
On each wrap spread:
steps.description:
2 tbsp Ricotta
50g feta crumbled
1 cup spinach

ingredients are per wrap*

steps.title: Place another wrap on top and toast in sandwich maker (or pan) 3mins,
steps.description: Slice and serve.

title: Cheese & Spinach Pie with Salad
description: A cheesy, vegetable pie loaded with eggs. Crispy and light, perfect for a summer’s day.

steps.title: Preheat oven to 180°C
Rinse 1 bunch shredded silver beet, place into pan on medium heat.
Cover and steam until sliver beet is wilted.
steps.description: Cool then drain out excess moisture using clean cloth.

steps.title: In a large bowl, combine:
steps.description:
1 Leek, sliced (white part only)
wilted silverbeet
2 teaspoon Dill
¼ teaspoon nutmeg
½ cup ricotta
1 cup crumbled feta
4 eggs
pinch of pepper

steps.title: Spray baking dish with oil then line with baking paper.
steps.description: Spread 1 filo pastry sheet into tray, spray with oil then place another sheet of filo on top.

steps.title: Repeat until 5 layers of pastry.
steps.description:
Fill the baking dish with silverbeet mixture.
Top with 5 more layers of pastry.

steps.title: Bake 45 minutes until cooked through and brown.
Serve with side salad.

title: Cajun Salmon with Corn Salsa
description: A light and refreshing meal that can be made as spicy as you like. The flaky fish pairs perfectly with the sweet and flavoursome salsa beneath.

ingredients.name: ¼ Pineapple, skin removed and diced

steps.title: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Sprinkle 1 tablespoon Cajun spice mix over 2 salmon fillets.
Heat fry pan to medium, add 1 tablespoon oil,
steps.description: (Pan needs to be oven proof and non-stick).

steps.title: Cook salmon skin down for 3mins until crispy, turn and transfer to oven:
steps.description:
5 mins for medium, OR
10 for well done.

steps.title: Meanwhile, for the salsa put another pan on medium heat, add :
steps.description:
1 cup frozen corn kernels
½ diced red capsicum

cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add ¼ diced pineapple to salsa mix, cook for one minute.
Remove salsa from heat, stir in:
steps.description:
½ cup parsley,
1 teaspoon chili flakes,
1 lime zest and juice.

steps.title: Divide salsa mix between 2 plates.
Serve Salmon on top of salsa.
Prepare 1 cup rice according to directions on pack.
Heat pan to medium, add 1 tablespoon olive oil and  1 diced onion,
steps.description: Cook until soft.

steps.title: Add 2 cloves crushed garlic, cook one minute.
Next add:
steps.description:
2 cups chopped broccoli
2 cups shredded silver beet
¼ cup of water

steps.title: Cover with lid and steam vegetables for 5 minutes.
Add rice, stir to combine, and cook a further 5 minutes with lid off.
Stir through the:
steps.description:
100g Feta, crumbled
1 Lemon (juice)
1 tbsp reduced salt Soy Sauce

Serve.

title: Breakfast Smoothie Bowl
description:
A deconstructed healthy fruit smoothie with plenty of fruit
Good serving of fruit to get your energy for the morning with a significant amount of fibre!

ingredients.name: 1 cup Granola (Special K Nourish is a good choice)

steps.title: Start this recipe the day before:
steps.description:
Chop 2 bananas into chunks,
place chunks into a container,
freeze overnight.

steps.title: Allow banana chunks to thaw on the bench for 10 minutes.
Place in food processor with 1 teaspoon vanilla. Blend until smooth.
Divide ingredients into the bowls:
steps.description:
1⁄2 cup Blueberries
1⁄2 cup Strawberries, cut into quarters
1⁄2 cup Almonds, chopped
2 tbsp desiccated coconut
1 cup of Granola

Serve.

steps.title: Bean Burrito: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook 1 diced onion until soft.
Add 2 cloves crushed garlic and cook for 1 minute,
Add 1 diced red capsicum, cook until soft.
Add:
steps.description:
1 can kidney beans
2 seeded and diced tomatoes
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp cayenne pepper

Stir then simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Guacamole: In a different bowl, mash together
steps.description:
1 avocado
½ lime (juice)
2 tbsp chopped parsley
½ tabasco sauce

steps.title: Salsa: In another bowl, combine:
steps.description:
½ cup corn kernels,
½ lime (juice),
2 tbsp chopped parsley,
2 tomatoes (seeded and diced).

steps.title: To serve Divide 1 chopped cos lettuce between 4 bowls.
Top with Bean Burrito mixture.
Add 2 tablespoons each of guacamole and salsa.
Top with Greek yoghurt (optional).

title: Baked Eggs with Tomatoes
description: Scrumptious baked eggs with chopped tomatoes for breakfast!A filling, high protein start to the day

steps.title: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a medium pan.
Add 1 sliced onion and fry until soft.
Add 2 cloves of crushed garlic and cook for a further minute.
Add the sliced capsicum and cook for 5-7 minutes until soft.
Add 2 cans of chopped tomatoes, spices and sugar to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer.
steps.description:
½ teaspoon of cayenne pepper,
1 teaspoon Cumin,
1 teaspoon smoked paprika,
1 pinch brown sugar

steps.title: Crack the eggs one at a time on top of the tomato mixture making sure to space them evenly around the pan.
Cover the pan and allow to simmer for another 10 mins until the eggs are cooked to your liking.
Top with parsley and serve with toast.

title: Avocado and Feta Cheese on Toast
description: A tasty spin on morning toast with avocado and feta cheese.Contains healthy fats and some carbs to get your day started.

ingredients.name: 4 slices of Wholegrain or Sourdough Bread

steps.title: Scoop 1 Avocado and 1 lemon’s juice into a small bowl,
Mash avocado with a fork.
Toast the 4 slices of bread,
Drizzle the Olive Oil over the toast,
Spread the Avocado mixture on the toast.
Crumble the 100g Feta on top of the avocado.
Sprinkle the ½ cup Parsley on top (optional).
